content:
sarah: launching rollout v3.4.2 now, canary->gradual. immediate post-deploy smoke will run (synth + kv prefill). tagging eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: rollout started: v3.4.2 canary at 10% -> monitoring synths (short-prompt, embed-route). prefill jobs queued.

owen: quick heads-up: last-minute change reduced tokenizer batch size for short prompts. watch short-prompt p50/p95.

lee: synthetic sweep kick: 500 samples per region. will post results in ~4m.

infra-bot: autoscaler note: quant2 pool at target=40, current=40. no scaling events.

deploy-bot: canary progress: 50% at 4650001255. prefill progress eu: 22% (slow), usw2: 88% (ok).

sarah: eu prefill looks slow. @infra-bot any anomalies?

infra-bot: noticed serialization on prefill tasks on eu hosts - many hosts restarting within last 6m (kube rolling restart). prefill worker max_parallelism=4.

owen: that explains it. tokenizer p95 on short-prompt jumped to ~380ms in eu at 14:07. other regions stable.

lee: synth failure rate eu=0.6% (threshold 0.2%). getting a few `429` linked to `quant2_pool_exhausted` in logs. sample lines: `ERROR model_alloc: quant2_pool_exhausted host=eu-42`.

sarah: action: pause further rollout, pin canary at 50%. don't rollback yet. increase prefill parallelism to 10 in eu only and restart prefill workers. prepare quick mitigation note.

deploy-bot: canary pinned at 50%. creating incident stub.

infra-bot: applying prefill_parallelism=10 to eu group. restarting prefill workers (graceful).

lee: re-running synthetic sweep after change.

owen: found that quant2 pool was near capacity due to a small memory regression in quant2 allocator added in v3.4.2. created short-term fix to reduce memory per worker; will push a runtime flag to reclaim ~8% memory.

sarah: do the runtime flag now as a canary-only patch, then measure. we want minimal surface change.

owen: runtime flag pushed to canary eu at 4650001282: `--quant2-worker-mem-saver`.

lee: post-mitigation synth: eu p95 back to 48ms, failure rate 0.03%. no new 429s observed for last 2m.

infra-bot: prefill progress eu reached 92% after bump.

sarah: decision: unpin and continue rollout to 100% with note to follow up. do NOT retroactively change model variant config. create tickets for: (1) quant2 allocator regression root cause, (2) autoscaler threshold tweak, (3) CI synthetic for short-prompt batch size.

deploy-bot: rollout completed -> 100%. draft_release_notes: "v3.4.2: tokenizer batch-size tweak for short prompts, temporary prefill parallelism increase in eu during rollout, runtime quant2 mem saver flag. Monitor quant2 pool metrics."

owen: filed INF-4802 for allocator regression.

lee: adding a new short-prompt synthetic to post-deploy smoke checklist (PR #842).

sarah: thanks team. follow-ups assigned. closing thread unless something else pops up. :white_check_mark:
